description.value: Shawarma 2 Go Grill is an authentic Mediterranean fast-food restaurant with over 30 years of shawarma expertise, located in the SeaFair Shopping Center in Richmond. The menu spans made-to-order wraps, rice plates, and fusion items such as Shawarma Poutine, with both meat and vegetarian selections including falafels, hummus, and dolmades. A second Richmond location at Brighouse is in the process of opening.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at shawarma2go.ca is live and confirms the OSM primary location at SeaFair Shopping Center, 5-8751 No 1 Rd, Richmond, BC. The homepage explicitly states 'Order online & pick up No fees at 5-8751 No 1 Road location', confirming takeout. The menu lists a 'Veggie Lover' plate and made-to-order falafels, confirming vegetarian options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
